fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-08-02, a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 45,000 was withdrawn. The time of the incident was given as 10:45 on 2025-07-27. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Nithin Murugan, using the number 9000000374. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100046, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, suspect, morning, bank account, screenshot, mobile number, shopping complex
